usedFor: Microsoft Dynamics CRM holds leads, orders and cases, and Microsoft Excel logs them through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new lead adds a row, giving you a plain table to sort and share outside the CRM.

watchOut: “New Lead” in Microsoft Dynamics CRM is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check.
